selection_protocol: Short error excerpts were taken from public issue reports and official project source/documentation. Labels were assigned manually after selecting the sources and after the RCA implementation already existed. The set is external-source-derived but not blind, preregistered, or independently labelled.
scope: Tests rule-based subcode prediction conditional on a supplied coarse failure_type. Does not test the incident detector's selection of failure_type.
limitations: Cases were curated after the rule implementation existed, so this is not a blind external evaluation.
Several cases are correlated by repository or error family and must not be treated as independent real-world failures.
The labels are manual, and ambiguous cases were excluded.
The set uses public issue reports and official source snippets; it is not a representative sample of ML production incidents.
